name: The Monsters of Willowdale
source:
You wake up just outside of Willowdale, a once-quiet village that has been terrorized by an unknown monster for the past few years. Joined by Ellie, the kind-hearted guard, Minieth, the brash mage, and Wren, the nervous druid, you must gather your wits about you to destroy the evil force and bring peace back to the land.

[From [url=https://amarvelous.itch.io/willowdale]Itch.io[/url]]
